description: P.W.D. Edwin Wasantha Kumara v. Hon. Attorney General P.W.D. Edwin Wasantha Kumara v. Hon. Attorney General View More before Hon. Deepali Wijesundera, J
parties: P.W.D. Edwin Wasantha Kumara v. Hon. Attorney General P.W.D. Edwin Wasantha Kumara v. Hon. Attorney General View More
keywords: Criminal appeal – Dishonest misappropriation/breach involving post-dated cheques – Purchase of glassware – Two cheques issued for Rs.261,346 and Rs.425,649 – Stop-payment instructions – Defence alleging damaged goods and trade practice of returns – No evidence that appellant actually returned damaged goods – Cheque as bill of exchange payable on demand – Subsequent stop-payment instructions proving dishonest intention – High Court finding upheld – Conviction and five-year sentence affirmed – Appeal dismissed. L.U. Jayasuriya J. agreed.
legistation: Penal Code – section 403; Bills of Exchange Act/Ordinance – section 73; Code of Criminal Procedure Act No. 15 of 1979 – section 331(1).
